title.narrative: Improving Access, Curriculum and Teaching in Medical Education (IMPACT-MED)

description.narrative: The IMPACT MED Alliance is a new partnership with the Brigham and Women's Hospital of the Harvard Medical School, American companies, and Vietnamese universities to improve the quality and effectiveness of medical education in Vietnam.
